results.title: New Research: Language Barriers Cost Businesses Deals
results.summary: Whisperr published a survey of 633 business leaders and workers examining how language differences affect international growth and everyday meetings. Key findings include that 1 in 5 business leaders say their company has lost a deal, client, or partner because of a language barrier, and 65% of workers who attend multilingual meetings have pretended to understand a conversation.
results.survey_focus: impact of language barriers on business deals and meetings

results.title: Study: 56% of Multilingual Workers Secretly Translate Their Workday
results.summary: In a separate survey of 736 U.S. workers who regularly use a non-native language on the job, Whisperr found that 56% secretly translate during their workday. The study explored the workarounds multilingual employees rely on, moments they fake understanding, and what language barriers cost them in time, money, and confidence.
results.survey_focus: behaviors of multilingual workers during workday
